[2026-05-23 19:33] CHORE-60 seed dispatch. Parallel workstream alongside the Svelte page implementation.

## Goal

Populate **polyphony** (our playground per [[polyphony-is-playground]] — PO classified explicitly this session) with the same content the mock fixtures in CHORE-60's `/library` page will carry, so the follow-up live-Entu wiring CHORE swaps the page's data source without changing rendered output.

## Source content

The Claude Design bundle's mock data. To re-extract:

```bash
python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('/home/michelek/workspace/docs/design/inbox/2026-05-23-librarian/bundle/mvox.eu-handoff.zip').extractall('/tmp/mvox-handoff')"
```

Then read `/tmp/mvox-handoff/mvox-eu/project/librarian/Data.jsx`. Contents in shorthand:

- **CHOIR** — Estonian Philharmonic Chamber Choir, slug `epcc`, 48-singer rehearsal size
- **MEMBERS** — 8 synthetic Estonian singers with voice assignments (`mt` Maris Tamm S1, `ls` Liina Saar S2, `al` Ave Lepp A, `kp` Kärt Põld A, `tm` Toomas Mägi T1, `av` Andres Vahar T2, `mr` Margus Roos B1, `hk` Henn Kuusik B2)
- **WORKS** — 13 works with editions, copies, loan state, locations. Real composers (Tallis, Pärt, Tormis, Kreek, Ešenvalds, Byrd, Whitacre, Nystedt, Lauridsen, Hildegard, Pärt-Beatitudes, Ešenvalds-Sleep). Includes 4 active overdue loans on Pärt Magnificat (UE-19400) — `#14`+`#15` with Henn since 2025-11-12, `#22`+`#23` with Margus since 2025-11-12, all 195 days overdue.

## Spec reference

Full context at `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-23-library-page-ui-kit-design.md` §11 (committed locally as `ebb1cbb`, not yet pushed pending PO review). Read it for the data-model framing + scope.

## Deliverables (two, sequenced)

### 1. Strategy doc — `docs/migration/findings/2026-05-23-librarian-seed-strategy.md`

Cover:
- **Entity mapping**: each bundle record → target v4E entity (`person`, `organization`, `library`, `work`, `edition`, `copy`, `lending`). Reference current schema at `~/projects/entu-research/docs/schema/v4E/schema.ts` — verify the exact entity types + property shapes available NOW.
- **Reuse vs create**: existing polyphony state probably has some of these works/composers already (Pärt, Tallis, Byrd are likely present). Decide per-entity: reuse existing instances + add new properties OR create fresh "EPCC-bundle" namespaced instances. Polyphony-is-playground rules apply — clashes are tolerable but propose cleanly.
- **Idempotency strategy**: how the seed checks "already done" and skips, plus a clean teardown path so we can re-run.
- **Loan/copy representation**: the bundle has per-copy state (`total`, `on_loan`, `overdue`, `returned_today`) PLUS a `loans[]` array on the overdue edition. Map to current `copy` + `lending` entities. The "returned today" notion may not have a direct entity; might just be a derived count from recent lending state.
- **Locations**: bundle has `location: "Cabinet B · shelf 1"` strings on a few editions. v4E may or may not have a location property — verify.
- **Privacy register**: log the EPCC org name + synthetic Estonian names as data sources in your scratchpad's privacy boundary register.

This is a thinking document. Commit it. Surface to me when ready.

### 2. Idempotent seed script — `scripts/migrations/seed-librarian-bundle-data.ts`

After I review your strategy doc:
- Idempotent (check-then-create per the prompt pattern)
- Source manifest at `scripts/migrations/seed-sources/librarian-bundle.json` (the bundle data exported as JSON for the script to consume)
- Dry-run mode default; live mode requires explicit env flag (`MVOX_SEED_LIVE=1` or similar — use whatever pattern is already in place for your other seeds)
- Result artifact at `scripts/migrations/seed-results/seed-librarian-bundle-<ISO-ts>.json` on each run
- Commit the script + the source manifest

## Authorization gate

**Live execution requires explicit `"I authorize this run"` SendMessage from me before you mutate polyphony.** Dry-run clean is NOT authorization. Strategy-doc approval is NOT authorization. The discipline holds even on the playground — per Bentham's session-9 "friction is the point" call-out + your own L77 corrective from session 18.

If 15+ min elapses since your dry-run-clean report without my authorization message, ping me for status per your standing protocol.

## Parallel work

You're not blocked on the Svelte implementation. I'm writing the implementation plan (writing-plans) in parallel with your strategy doc. Both streams land independently; they meet when the page's data layer swaps from mock to live Entu (which is a follow-up CHORE, not this one).

## Branch

Create `chore/seed-librarian-bundle` from main. Land your commits there. Team-lead routes any merge.

Surface the strategy doc when ready.
